items.title: Ford blasts White House criticism of China tech partners, calls Duffy letter 'wrongheaded'
items.summary: Ford stock was volatile a day after the White House questioned its strategy of using Chinese partners. Ford responded after the bell in a forceful manner, hinting as possible behind the scenes drama.

items.title: Ford Finally Runs Out Of EVs
items.summary: Ford's multibillion-dollar EV ambitions collapsed faster than almost anyone predicted, and the company's bold plan to rebuild from scratch raises more questions than it answers.

items.title: Ford Faces ‘Profound Concern’ Over China Ties. What That Means for the Stock.
items.summary: The letter takes aim at Ford’s licensing of Chinese battery technology and joint venture with Chinese auto maker Geely in Europe.  “And the Company’s ongoing talks with  BYD  for hybrid vehicle components could lead to further embedding subsidized foreign technology into Ford’s core supply chains.”  Ford posted a response online challenging how some of Duffy’s concerns were framed.
